sentences.text: Arctolepis was an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish, a type of armored jawed fish.
The genus was first described by Eastman in 1908.
Arctolepis belongs to the class Placodermi.
Its parent group is the family Arctolepididae.
It is classified within the paraphyletic grouping Phylctaenii inside the clade Phlyctaenioidei.
The genus is most closely related to the genera Heintzosteus and Dicksonosteus.
Six species are included in the genus: A. brevis, A. decipiens, A. lata, A. lewini, A. longicornis, and A. solnoerdali.
These fish lived during the Early Devonian period, specifically from the Pragian to the Emsian stages, between 413.02 and 393.47 million years ago.
Fossils have been found in modern-day Norway and Michigan.
